cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sqlite-core-interface LANGUAGES C)

# SRS 001 FR-4: see cmake/SqliteCppLibrary.cmake for what this does and why
# no sibling sqlite-cpp library is linked against here. ctime.c (sqlite3CompileOptions)
# is generated by mkctimec.tcl -- there's no static source for it, only the generated
# one, same pattern as compiler-parser's parse.c.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake/SqliteCppLibrary.cmake)
sqlite_cpp_add_library(core-interface ${SQLITE_GENDIR}/ctime.c)
